_comment: Playwright MCP: lets the Claude session DRIVE a real Chrome (navigate, click, fill, read network + console) so the user only does login/captcha/2FA. Persistent profile = log in once. EDIT per program: (1) append the program's required UA tag if any (e.g. 'BugBounty/42 (YWH)'); (2) put OOS hosts in --blocked-origins. Restart Claude Code after editing. Profile dir holds session cookies — keep it gitignored.
